first_impression.reaction: Our daughter sent this one. It's plain and sensible, with no silly slang, and seven venues is far easier to follow than a list of fifteen. I read it top to bottom on the iPad. What pleased me most was the section on money and contracts: deposits, currency, whose name is on the contract. Those are exactly my questions, and they're written down for me. There's a step-free question and a line about insurance too. What I still can't see is a rough price in AUD, or who we actually ring if something goes wrong over there.

journey.quote: Seminyak sits on Bali's southwest coast, on the beach that stretches north from Kuta and Legian, and it faces the sunset over the Indian Ocean.
journey.reaction: Clear. I know roughly where it is now, and it isn't trying to sell me a dream in the first line.

journey.quote: None of the seven publishes exclusive use of the whole property, so ask in writing whether your ceremony and reception spaces can be closed to other guests.
journey.reaction: Honest. I'd rather be told what they don't say than find strangers wandering through the ceremony.

journey.quote: A pool-party reception for a crowd that will swim before dinner.
journey.reaction: Not for our family. Mum on a dive tower? I skipped through this one quickly, though I can see the young ones might like it.

journey.section: Money and contracts: questions to ask each venue
journey.quote: Whose name is on the contract, and in what currency is it written and paid?
journey.reaction: Finally, someone asks the question I'd ask. I'll print this list for Geoff.

journey.section: Money and contracts: questions to ask each venue
journey.quote: How much deposit is due, when, and at what point does it become non-refundable?
journey.reaction: Good. But it's a question for us to ask the venue. Is the deposit protected if the venue goes under? The page doesn't say what Wedded Concierge does about that.

journey.section: Access: questions about the beach and the evening
journey.quote: How do guests reach the sand, and is there a step-free route between the ceremony and dinner?
journey.reaction: Thank you. My mother uses a walking frame and this is the first thing I'd worry about on a beach. I'd still like to know which of these venues actually has one.

journey.quote: When should travel insurance be in place relative to your first deposit, and does it cover the wedding itself?
journey.reaction: Sensible, though it's only a question. With older guests I'd want it to say medical cover plainly.

journey.section: How do guests get to Seminyak?
journey.quote: Damaged passports, including water damage or minor tears, have led to refused entry, so ask guests to check theirs early.
journey.reaction: I'd never have known. I'll tell Mum to dig hers out now.

journey.section: How do guests get to Seminyak?
journey.quote: Volcanic activity can bring flight delays, cancellations or airport closures with little or no notice, so build a buffer day into the guest schedule.
journey.reaction: Practical. A buffer day is exactly what older travellers need anyway.

journey.section: When should you marry in Seminyak?
journey.quote: Know your venue's emergency plans, and keep the local numbers to hand: ambulance and rescue 118, police 110 or 112.
journey.reaction: Useful, but the number I really want is who from your side I ring at 2am Bali time.

journey.section: Can foreigners legally get married in Bali?
journey.quote: Persons of any nationality may generally marry in Indonesia if they hold a religion recognised by the Indonesian Government, listed as Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism or Christian, and both parties must hold the same religion.
journey.reaction: Neither of them is religious. So is it a legal wedding at home and a ceremony in Bali? It doesn't say what most couples actually do.

journey.section: Shortlist your Seminyak venues with a Wedded Advisor
journey.quote: Your Wedded Advisor is one person, start to finish, who works in your time zone and quotes in AUD for Australian couples.
journey.reaction: One person, AUD, our time zone. That's what I want. I'd still want a name and a phone call.

journey.section: Shortlist your Seminyak venues with a Wedded Advisor
journey.quote: Wedded Concierge plans venue, travel, vendors and payments, anywhere in the world, and the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins.
journey.reaction: Fee in writing first, and they handle payments. That's someone accountable.

unanswered_questions: Are our deposits protected if a Bali venue or supplier fails? (deferred business detail)
Who do we ring if something goes wrong in Bali after hours, and is anyone from Wedded Wonderland there on the day? (deferred business detail)
Which of these seven venues actually have step-free access between the ceremony and dinner spaces?
Roughly what does a Seminyak wedding at these venues cost, From AUD?
Should older guests have travel insurance with medical cover, and do you advise on it?
If the couple don't share a recognised religion, what do most Australians do?
Is the first conversation a phone call with a real person, and can I join it as a parent paying part?

turn_offs_found.quote: How much deposit is due, when, and at what point does it become non-refundable?
turn_offs_found.why: Not a turn-off in itself, it's the right question. But it leaves the asking to us. My card's turn-off is no mention of who is responsible for our money, and the page still doesn't say whether Wedded Concierge protects deposits.

turn_offs_found.quote: Not published: guest capacity, villa count, exclusive use.
turn_offs_found.why: Lines like this repeat under almost every venue. On the iPad they start to blur, and I'm left wondering what I'm actually comparing.

would_share_with: My husband, the 'Money and contracts' question list and the closing paragraph about the fee in writing and AUD quotes
My mother, the passport damage line and the step-free route question
My daughter, the religion requirement in the legal section, before anyone books anything

cta_reaction.quote: Your Wedded Advisor is one person, start to finish, who works in your time zone and quotes in AUD for Australian couples.
cta_reaction.why: The right words, and the money questions make me trust it more than most. I'd talk to Geoff first, then I'd want a phone call with a real person about deposit protection and who we ring on the day.

top_3_changes: Next to the money and contracts questions, add one line on what Wedded Concierge does about deposits and payments, only if the business confirms it; otherwise flag it.
Say who the family contacts if something goes wrong in Bali (the Wedded Advisor, hours, how), only if confirmed by the business.
In the insurance questions, add a sourced line that older guests should check medical cover, and note which venues publish step-free access, or say none do.

Journey types limited to gained_trust, lost_trust, confused, bored, excited, objection

No invented brand facts; deposit protection, on-the-day contact and pricing placed in unanswered_questions
VERIFY markers and HTML comments (fact tags, image slots) ignored

open_questions.question: Can the business confirm what Wedded Concierge does about deposits, payments and on-the-day contact in Bali, so one line can be added? If not, flag rather than fill.
